edits.old: Then a failed write changes nothing and the caller sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then a failed write changes nothing and the caller sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC18 Activity retried or timed out
    Given an activity of WriteOffWorkflow is retried or exceeds its timeout
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then nothing is written and no move is answered until the retry succeeds
    Then the retry follows the workflow's own schedule

  Scenario: AC19 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given rwb-case, rwb-decision or the reference-data read fails or does not answer
    When the step calls it
    Then the step writes nothing and answers no move
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC20 Status change not allowed is refused
    Given a case requests a status change that no rule row of section 8 allows
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing is written
    Then the case keeps its current state

edits.old: | TC-E6-022-18 | The decision is recorded with the rule ID and the package version before anything leaves; a failed write changes nothing | Component | The decision for the case is ready |
edits.new:
| TC-E6-022-18 | The decision is recorded with the rule ID and the package version before anything leaves; a failed write changes nothing | Component | The decision for the case is ready |
| TC-E6-022-19 | AC18: an activity that is retried or times out writes nothing and answers no move until the retry succeeds | Component | An activity of WriteOffWorkflow is retried or exceeds its timeout |
| TC-E6-022-20 | AC19: a consumed call that fails or does not answer writes nothing, answers no move and answers 503 | Component | rwb-case, rwb-decision or the reference-data read fails or does not answer |
| TC-E6-022-21 | AC20: a status change that no rule row of section 8 allows is refused and nothing is written | Component | A case requests a status change that no rule row allows |
